title: knowledge.fix_published.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the FixPublished event payload (EDR-INCIDENT-01 D1): a vendor fix the estate did not have before is now on record for a package an OPEN occurrence carries — the occurrence was re-judged against the card that learned the bound and is still behind it. Per occurrence, once per (occurrence, bound). It decides nothing and changes no verdict; Governance digests these per release and tells a person.

Package.description: The fix-attribution key the bounds were selected by: the source package for a distro component, else the name.

Fixes.description: The NEW bounds this re-judgement found the install below that the previous judgement did not know.

Advisories.description: The vendor advisories that shipped them, when the card's statements say (EDR-VEX-02 D14).
